reviews.reason: Reviewed the complete assigned proof and its actual collar, transversal, recurrence and accessibility suppliers. A compact recurrent B would be closed in M and contain its limit x in L, contradicting B≠L; hence B is noncompact. The restored ambient setting and ACω permit the transversal supplier. A strict positive return gives an open mutual-accessibility class; mutual accessibility with L would produce a forbidden closed transversal. Saturated closure carries the accumulation at x to all of L, proving L⊆∂M S. This is a local repair review, not an independent audit of the repair.
